hooks.command: grep -Eq 'git +reset +--hard|git +clean +-[a-zA-Z]*f|git +checkout +(-- +)?\.([^A-Za-z0-9_/-]|$)|git +restore +(-- +)?\.([^A-Za-z0-9_/-]|$)|git +stash +(drop|clear)|git +branch +-D' && { echo 'That command throws away work with no way back: git reset --hard, clean -f, checkout/restore over the whole tree, stash drop/clear, branch -D. Ask the user to run it themselves, or undo the specific edit instead.' >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0
